title: ArchiGenMS: A Neuro-Symbolic Evolutionary Framework for Greenfield Microservice Design
venue: Anais do XXIX Congresso Ibero-Americano em Engenharia de Software

publication.venue: Anais do XXIX Congresso Ibero-Americano em Engenharia de Software

mechanism.domainTask: Greenfield microservice decomposition from user stories
mechanism.populationDetail: A single pool of 10 candidate decompositions is maintained; no persistent islands or genealogy tree is described.
mechanism.archiveDetail: Five elite candidates are retained per generation; no descriptor-based quality-diversity archive is described.
mechanism.replacementDetail: The paper reports five generations and per-generation population and elite sizes, but does not specify how survivors are carried forward or whether the previous population is replaced.
mechanism.generationDetail: Generation 0 is from-scratch from user stories; later offspring broadly revise one selected valid parent using LLM semantic variation.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Lean validity and architecture proxy metrics determine candidate fitness and elite retention.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: One valid parent is selected, but the precise rule for choosing it is not reported; inspiration candidates are context only.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: A Lean 4 validation kernel imposes formal structural invariants in the loop; these checks cover only the paper's chosen abstraction, not complete architectural correctness.
